# Public old/new no-impact fixture

This is a deterministic `fixture_contract` journey, generated by
`uv run --frozen python -m tests.build_assurance_no_impact_fixture` from the sealed 002 plan,
the public 004 before/current candidate pair, and the labelled test signing key. The old
subject and gate use the before candidate at 10:00 UTC and pass. The current gate uses
the updated candidate at 11:00 UTC, reuses the old assessment, and carries a signed
review issued at 10:30 UTC. The review binds the old assessment, both subject and
policy digests, and every changed path, including `/as_of`.

The current assessment records that authenticated review, but stays `stale` and widens
to `whole_gate`: the later evaluation time cannot inherit the old pass. It also retains
the 004 native dependency paths from the changed component requirement to its interface
and test case. Its closed
assessment and separate fixture trust context reproduce the historical stale result
after relocation. The selected times are fixture inputs, not protected production time.
No fixture key, receipt, or review grants production authority.
